title: ProcessGroup
description: Schema for Process Group (L1) entries in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-processes. CR-BP-12; downstream of CR-BP-11 (L1 Process Group discovery register) and CR-BP-04 (ID-family contract). A Process Group is a catalog-owned record type that organizes Business Process specializations within a Process Context (Domain x Lifecycle Stage cell). The Process Group is NOT a metamodel entity; it is catalog-owned and lives only in this catalog. The canonical containment direction is `L1 group --composes--> L2 process`; the inverse `part_of` is a derived view recorded on the L2 side for navigation. ID family: `dea:group-*` (CR-BP-04 §4).

type.description: Discriminator. Always 'ProcessGroup' for Process Group entries (mirror of `dea:BusinessProcess` / `type: Process` on L2).

id.description: Stable Process Group id. CR-BP-04 §4 family. Convention: dea:group-<kebab-name>. The id must be stable across renames of name/definition; renames go through the CR-programme.

definition.description: Normative semantic meaning of this Process Group. Not a description; a definition. PG-006 (MECE) depends on this being non-overlapping with peer Process Groups in the same Process Context.

process_context.description: Reference to the canonical Process Context (dea:pc-*) within which this Process Group organizes L2 processes. PG-003 enforces resolution to a known context.

excludes.description: Explicitly excluded responsibilities (belong in adjacent contexts or peer Process Groups).

outcomes.description: Intended enterprise outcomes for this Process Group. The outcomes distinguish this Process Group from peer Process Groups in the same Process Context.

composes.description: Canonical containment relationships: every entry declares that this Process Group composes a Business Process specialization. Each entry conforms to the metamodel relationship-instance.json (source_id, target_id, relationship_type, plus optional direction, status, effective_from/to, asserted_by, rationale, evidence, provenance). PG-004 (target_id pattern) and PG-005 (target resolution) enforce.

relationship_type.description: The Process Group's canonical containment relationship is `composes`. Other relationship types are not permitted in this array.

process_group_kind.description: Process Group classification. Controlled vocabulary at classifications/process-group-kinds.yaml. PG-007 enforces.

status.description: Discovery / governance status (mirrors CR-BP-11 register disposition values).

lifecycle_status.description: Catalog entry lifecycle. `active` requires at least one composes entry with status: active (PG-008).

evidence.description: Optional: structured evidence supporting the Process Group definition.

cross_context_overlap.description: Optional: explicit declaration of other Process Contexts this Process Group participates in via cross-context membership. PG-006 enforces intent vs. accident.

links.description: Optional: navigation links to related artifacts (documentation, change requests, research register). Same shape as in L2 entity entries.

ecfConformance.description: Optional: ECF conformance posture. Process Groups inherit the catalog posture by default; only declare this block if the Process Group has ECF conformance specifics distinct from the catalog. CR-ECF-CG-004 §10.
